items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: One piano player, I think it was Fats Pichio. First time to put that raincoat on and play the callio up, you didn't realize that the keys was hot. It's cost his finger sound.

ctx.x: Any other people play county out that you know?

Well all the guys that work on the river boats. Similar to a county, it's not a very hard deal. But it's, it's, uh, Wicked by steam. Steam boiler. And there's copper keys on it. You have to play it with gloves on. And a raincoat and a rain hat. Over your uniform. Your band uniform. Because the steam came from all directions. And the keys get awfully, awfully hot. That's why you use copper keys. And this copper, you have to be careful. This copper would get in your skin. One piano player, I think it was Fats…
It was a real haunting sound there in the evening.
